segments.ja367:1.1: Yvāyaṃ sāḷiya [sāliya (sī. syā. pī.), sāḷika (?)] chāpoti, kaṇhasappaṃ agāhayi;
segments.ja367:2.1: Ahantāra [ahananta (pī.), aharanta (?)] mahantāraṃ, yo naro hantumicchati;
segments.ja367:2.3: Evaṃ so nihato seti, yathāyaṃ puriso hato.
segments.ja367:3.1: Ahantāra [ahananta (sī. syā. pī.), aharanta (?)] maghātentaṃ, yo naro hantumicchati;
segments.ja367:3.3: Evaṃ so nihato seti, yathāyaṃ puriso hato.
segments.ja367:4.3: Tameva so rajo hanti, tathāyaṃ puriso hato.
segments.ja367:5.1: Yo appaduṭṭhassa narassa dussati, suddhassa posassa anaṅgaṇassa;
segments.ja367:5.3: Tameva bālaṃ pacceti pāpaṃ, sukhumo rajo paṭivātaṃva khittoti.
